_about: My manual read of roadmap 6b's Muse-written drop-F variants (runs/dropf_01) before any of them runs, as autogen_02's phase4_policy_review.json (the standing rule). valid: the variant's request fits exactly its intended matches (two or more), refers to one record, and the action can be done to each intended match; natural: a user could say it. An invalid variant goes to roadmap_01/known_defects.json (curated, leave out), which the runner, the policy stage and the scoring read. Read with the scratch viewer variant_view.py (original request, variant request, every candidate).
